text:
As in a chamber whose floor

is fine marble, an idle boy,

with nimble hand and spirited gesture,

whips a little rounded top;


while he sees its circling course

last in the sphere his fury struck,

he pauses; seeing it come to rest,

he strikes again the sounding linen.


So Love, with harsh violence,

in the shifting realm of my care,

makes a game of wounding my heart.


And though pain's diligence is more than enough,

when it sees me quiet, laid low,

it is offended by that quiet.

translation.title: As in a chamber of fine marble
